==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂er-}} From {{inh|en|enm|redy}}, {{m|enm|redi}}, {{m|enm|rædiȝ}}, {{m|enm|iredi}}, {{m|enm|ȝerædi|ȝerǣdi}}, alteration ({{suffix|en||y}}) of earlier {{m|enm|ired|irēd}}, {{m|enm|irede}}, {{m|enm|ȝerad|ȝerād|ready, prepared}}, from {{inh|en|ang|rǣde}}, {{m|ang|ġerǣde}} (also {{m|ang|ġerȳde}}) {{gloss|"prepared, prompt, ready, ready for riding (horse), mounted (on a horse), skilled, simple, easy"}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*garaidijaz}}, {{m|gem-pro|*raidijaz}}, from base {{m|gem-pro|*raidaz||ready}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₂reh₁dʰ-}}, {{m|ine-pro|*h₂reh₁-||to count, put in order, arrange, make comfortable}} and also probably conflated with {{der|en|ine-pro|*reydʰ-||to ride}} in the sense of ''"set to ride, able or fit to go, ready"''. Cognate with {{cog|sco|readie}}, {{m|sco|reddy||ready, prepared}}, {{cog|fy|ree||ready}}, {{cog|nl|gereed||ready}}, {{cog|de|bereit||ready}}, {{cog|da|rede||ready}}, {{cog|sv|redo||ready, fit, prepared}}, {{cog|no|reiug||ready, prepared}}, {{cog|is|greiður||easy, light}}, {{cog|got|𐌲𐌰𐍂𐌰𐌹𐌸𐍃||arranged, ordered}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|rĕd'i|a=RP,GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛd.i/}} ** {{audio|en|en-uk-ready.ogg|a=UK}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-ready.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹed.i/|a=AU,NZ}} * {{IPA|en|a=Indic|/ˈrɛɖi/}} * {{homophones|en|reddy|Reddy|aa=Indic,only if without gemination}} * {{hyph|en|read|y}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛdi|s=2}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj|er}} # [[prepare|Prepared]] for immediate action or use. #: {{ux|en|I made '''ready''' to set out on my journey.}} #: {{ux|en|The troops are '''ready''' for battle.}} #: {{ux|en|The porridge is '''ready''' to serve.}} #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Regained|book=Samson Agonistes|87|passage=If need be, I am '''ready''' to forego / And quit:}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1711|author=w:Jonathan Swift|title=journal to Stella |passage=she was told dinner was ready}} #* {{quote-video game|en|developer=w:BioWare|title=w:Mass Effect 2|genre=[[science fiction|Science Fiction]]|location=Redwood City|publisher=Electronic Arts|year=2010|system=PC|scene={{w|Normandy (Mass Effect)|Normandy SR-2}}|oclc=865290061|passage={{w|Miranda Lawson|Miranda}}: I'll admit it, Shepard. I'm impressed. You got us here. Are you '''ready'''?
Shepard: We're going in blind, and we don't even know if we'll survive the trip. No way in hell we're '''ready'''... but we don't have a choice.}} ## {{lb|en|prepositive}} {{ng|first only used {{lg|predicative}}ly, freely used from the end of the 17th century}} {{defdate|from c. 1550's}} ##: {{ux|en|a loaf of '''ready'''-sliced bread}} ##: {{ux|en|The cave was like a [['''ready'''-made]] home for us.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|1565|title=A briefe and piththie summe of the Christian faith|author=w:Theodore Beza|translator=Robert Fyll|chapter_plain=The 7 poynt, of the clericall tonsure|page=149r|pageurl=https://www.google.fr/books/edition/A_briefe_and_piththie_sic_summe_of_the_C/l_piAAAAcAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA1-PA149-IA1&printsec=frontcover|text=First their must be a clericall tonſure whereas they clyp thꝛee oꝛ fowꝛe lyttle heaires in his crowne, and he muſt{{...}}be hold a Priest '''ready''' made able to haue a benefice,{{...}}}} ##* {{RQ:Jonson Devil|page=98|text=But you muſt take a body '''ready''' made, ''Pug''
I can create you none{{...}}}} ##* {{quote-book|en|1696|volume=9-11|page=8|title=A Collection for Improvement of Husbandry and Trade|text={{...}}and whoever can keep their ''Corps'' till they can ſend to ''London'', and have a '''''ready'''-made Coffin'' ſent down, may afterwards have them kept any reaſonable time.}} ##* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:The Monthly Review (London)|1795|volume=XVI|page=316|pageurl=https://www.google.fr/books/edition/The_Monthly_Review/MjMNmCvlOtcC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA316&printsec=frontcover|publisher:w:Ralph Griffith|title=Price's Eſſay on the Pictureſques|text={{...}}but, in the improvement of a place in which Nature has furnished few materials in which the groundwork of improvement is tame, and in which suitable diſtances cannot be had, the rules of ſcience and the "'''ready'''-made taste" of connoiſſeurs are of little avail to the artiſt.}} # [[inclined|Inclined]]; [[apt]] to happen. # [[liable|Liable]] at any moment. #: {{syn|en|fit|}} #: {{ux|en|The seed is '''ready''' to sprout.}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merchant of Venice|act=IV|scene=i|passage=My heart is '''ready''' to crack.}} # Not slow or hesitating; quick in action or perception of any kind. #: {{syn|en|dexterous|prompt|easy|expert}} #: {{ux|en|a '''ready''' apprehension}} #: {{ux|en|'''ready''' wit}} #: {{ux|en|a '''ready''' writer or workman}} #* {{RQ:Scott Ivanhoe|passage=whose temper was '''ready''', though surly}} #* {{RQ:Macaulay History of England|chapter=13|passage='''ready''' in devising expedients}} #* {{RQ:Jefferies Amateur Poacher|chapter=The First Gun|page=16|passage=Molly the dairymaid came a little way from the rickyard, and said she would pluck the pigeon that very night after work. She was always '''ready''' to do anything for us boys; and we could never quite make out why they scolded her so for an idle hussy indoors. It seemed so unjust. Looking back, I recollect she had very beautiful brown eyes.}} #* {{RQ:Kipling Jungle Book|book=2|version=Century|story=The King's Ankus|page=188|passage="Apple of Death" is what the Jungle call
